messages.author: 890c64c56aea6f77
messages.subject: Re: How to use sliderInput as the choices argument in selectInput function in Rshiny
parts:
I suggest you try a conditionalPanel. See http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#dynamic-ui . 

There's a relevant example in the help file on conditionalPanel:

sidebarPanel(
   selectInput(
      "plotType", "Plot Type",
      c(Scatter = "scatter",
        Histogram = "hist")),

   # Only show this panel if the plot type is a histogram
   conditionalPanel(
      condition = "input.plotType == 'hist'",
      selectInput(
         "breaks", "Breaks",
         c("Sturges",
           "Scott",
           "Freedman-Diaconis",
           "[Custom]" = "custom")),

      # Only show this panel if Custom is selected
      conditionalPanel(
         condition = "input.breaks == 'custom'",
         sliderInput("breakCount", "Break Count", min=1, max=1000, value=10)
      )
   )
)

messages.subject: Re: How to use sliderInput as the choices argument in selectInput function in Rshiny
parts:
You can use updateSelectInput() to update an existing select input
using the value(s) returned from the slider input.
